COLDWAR_UAE_sync_treaty_spirits = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			is_subject_of = ENG
			has_country_flag = COLDWAR_UAE_withdrawal_schedule_active
			has_country_flag = COLDWAR_UAE_historical_withdrawal_schedule
			country_exists = ENG
		}
		if = { limit = { NOT = { has_idea = COLDWAR_UAE_treaty_dependence } } add_ideas = COLDWAR_UAE_treaty_dependence }
		ENG = { if = { limit = { NOT = { has_idea = COLDWAR_UAE_ENG_withdrawal_announced } } add_ideas = COLDWAR_UAE_ENG_withdrawal_announced } }
	}
	else = {
		remove_ideas = COLDWAR_UAE_treaty_dependence
		ENG = { remove_ideas = COLDWAR_UAE_ENG_withdrawal_announced }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			is_subject_of = ENG
			has_country_flag = COLDWAR_UAE_withdrawal_schedule_active
			NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_UAE_historical_withdrawal_schedule }
			country_exists = ENG
		}

		ENG = { if = { limit = { NOT = { has_idea = COLDWAR_UAE_ENG_withdrawal_treaty } } add_ideas = COLDWAR_UAE_ENG_withdrawal_treaty } }
	}
	else = {
		remove_ideas = COLDWAR_UAE_withdrawal_treaty
		ENG = { remove_ideas = COLDWAR_UAE_ENG_withdrawal_treaty }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			is_subject_of = ENG
			has_country_flag = COLDWAR_UAE_protection_accepted
			NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_UAE_withdrawal_schedule_active }
			country_exists = ENG
		}
		if = { limit = { NOT = { has_idea = COLDWAR_UAE_protection_compact } } add_ideas = COLDWAR_UAE_protection_compact }
		ENG = { if = { limit = { NOT = { has_idea = COLDWAR_UAE_ENG_protection_compact } } add_ideas = COLDWAR_UAE_ENG_protection_compact } }
	}
	else = {
		remove_ideas = COLDWAR_UAE_protection_compact
		ENG = { remove_ideas = COLDWAR_UAE_ENG_protection_compact }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			is_subject = no
			has_country_flag = COLDWAR_UAE_release_notice
			country_exists = ENG
		}
		if = { limit = { NOT = { has_idea = COLDWAR_UAE_withdrawal_fulfilled } } add_ideas = COLDWAR_UAE_withdrawal_fulfilled }
		ENG = { if = { limit = { NOT = { has_idea = COLDWAR_UAE_ENG_withdrawal_fulfilled } } add_ideas = COLDWAR_UAE_ENG_withdrawal_fulfilled } }
	}
	else = {
		remove_ideas = COLDWAR_UAE_withdrawal_fulfilled
		ENG = { remove_ideas = COLDWAR_UAE_ENG_withdrawal_fulfilled }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			is_subject = no
			has_country_flag = COLDWAR_UAE_friendship_accepted
			NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_UAE_release_notice }
			country_exists = ENG
		}
		if = { limit = { NOT = { has_idea = COLDWAR_UAE_friendship_treaty } } add_ideas = COLDWAR_UAE_friendship_treaty }

COLDWAR_UAE_init_british = {
	if = {
	 limit = { tag = UAE IMP_is_1970_scenario = yes COLDWAR_UAE_british_subject_live = yes NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_UAE_treaty_state_initialised } }

	 set_country_flag = COLDWAR_UAE_withdrawal_schedule_active
	 set_country_flag = COLDWAR_UAE_historical_withdrawal_schedule
	 set_country_flag = COLDWAR_UAE_withdrawal_origin_1968

	 ENG = { set_variable = { COLDWAR_UAE_treaty_nonce = UAE.COLDWAR_UAE_treaty_nonce } }
	 COLDWAR_UAE_sync_treaty_spirits = yes
	}
	COLDWAR_UAE_update_decision_prices = yes
}

COLDWAR_UAE_execute_release = {
	if = {
	 limit = { tag = UAE COLDWAR_UAE_british_subject_live = yes has_country_flag = COLDWAR_UAE_withdrawal_schedule_active NOT = { COLDWAR_UAE_before_current_release_due = yes } }
	 ENG = { end_puppet = UAE }
	 if = {
	  limit = { is_subject = no }
	  clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_UAE_withdrawal_schedule_active
	  clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_UAE_protection_accepted
	  clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_UAE_historical_withdrawal_schedule
	  set_country_flag = COLDWAR_UAE_withdrawal_agreed
	  set_country_flag = COLDWAR_UAE_release_contract_fulfilled

	  set_variable = { COLDWAR_UAE_actual_release_date = global.date }
	  add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_UAE_treaty_nonce = 1 }
	  ENG = { set_variable = { COLDWAR_UAE_treaty_nonce = UAE.COLDWAR_UAE_treaty_nonce } }
	  COLDWAR_UAE_sync_treaty_spirits = yes
	  COLDWAR_UAE_refresh_programmes = yes
	  ingame_update_setup = yes
	 }
	}
}

COLDWAR_UAE_close_protection_offer = {
	clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_UAE_offer_pending_protection
	clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_UAE_offer_awaiting_protection
	set_country_flag = { flag = COLDWAR_UAE_offer_cooldown_protection days = 180 }
}

COLDWAR_UAE_close_friendship_offer = {
	clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_UAE_offer_pending_friendship
	clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_UAE_offer_awaiting_friendship
	set_country_flag = { flag = COLDWAR_UAE_offer_cooldown_friendship days = 180 }
}

COLDWAR_UAE_focus_british_cofinance = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			tag = UAE
			IMP_is_1970_scenario = yes
			has_country_flag = COLDWAR_UAE_done_enduring_protection
			NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_UAE_focus_offer_delivered_british_cofinance }
		}
		set_country_flag = COLDWAR_UAE_focus_offer_requested_british_cofinance
		if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					has_country_flag = COLDWAR_UAE_focus_offer_delivered_british_cofinance
					check_variable = { var = COLDWAR_UAE_offer_round_british_cofinance value = 0 compare = greater_than }
					has_country_flag = COLDWAR_UAE_british_development_grant_paid
				}
			}
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_UAE_focus_offer_delivered_british_cofinance
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_UAE_focus_offer_requested_british_cofinance
		}
		else = {
			if = {
				limit = {
					country_exists = ENG
					NOT = { has_war_with = ENG }
				}
				ENG = { save_event_target_as = COLDWAR_UAE_contract_recipient }
				COLDWAR_UAE_send_british_cofinance_offer = yes
				if = {
					limit = {
						check_variable = { var = COLDWAR_UAE_offer_round_british_cofinance value = 0 compare = greater_than }
					}
					set_country_flag = COLDWAR_UAE_focus_offer_delivered_british_cofinance
					clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_UAE_focus_offer_requested_british_cofinance
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

COLDWAR_UAE_focus_preview_british_cofinance = {
	effect_tooltip = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = {
					OR = {
						has_country_flag = COLDWAR_UAE_focus_offer_delivered_british_cofinance
						check_variable = { var = COLDWAR_UAE_offer_round_british_cofinance value = 0 compare = greater_than }
						has_country_flag = COLDWAR_UAE_british_development_grant_paid
					}
				}
			}
			custom_effect_tooltip = TT_IF_THEY_ACCEPT
			set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_UAE_focus_preview_price_british_cofinance = gdp_total }
			multiply_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_UAE_focus_preview_price_british_cofinance = 0 }
			ENG = {
				set_temp_variable = { treasury_change = -0.25 }
				modify_treasury_effect = yes
			}
			set_temp_variable = { treasury_change = 0.25 }
			modify_treasury_effect = yes
		}
	}
}

COLDWAR_UAE_close_british_cofinance_offer = {
	clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_UAE_offer_pending_british_cofinance
	clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_UAE_offer_awaiting_british_cofinance
	set_country_flag = { flag = COLDWAR_UAE_offer_cooldown_british_cofinance days = 180 }
}

COLDWAR_UAE_focus_bahrain = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			tag = UAE
			IMP_is_1970_scenario = yes
			has_country_flag = COLDWAR_UAE_done_nine_states
			NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_UAE_focus_offer_delivered_bahrain }
		}
		set_country_flag = COLDWAR_UAE_focus_offer_requested_bahrain
		if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					has_country_flag = COLDWAR_UAE_focus_offer_delivered_bahrain
					check_variable = { var = COLDWAR_UAE_offer_round_bahrain value = 0 compare = greater_than }
					has_country_flag = COLDWAR_UAE_bahrain_charter_accepted
				}
			}
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_UAE_focus_offer_delivered_bahrain
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_UAE_focus_offer_requested_bahrain
		}
		else = {
			if = {
				limit = {
					country_exists = BHR
					NOT = { has_war_with = BHR }
				}
				BHR = { save_event_target_as = COLDWAR_UAE_contract_recipient }
				COLDWAR_UAE_send_bahrain_offer = yes
				if = {
					limit = {
						check_variable = { var = COLDWAR_UAE_offer_round_bahrain value = 0 compare = greater_than }
					}
					set_country_flag = COLDWAR_UAE_focus_offer_delivered_bahrain
					clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_UAE_focus_offer_requested_bahrain
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

COLDWAR_UAE_focus_preview_bahrain = {
	effect_tooltip = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = {
					OR = {
						has_country_flag = COLDWAR_UAE_focus_offer_delivered_bahrain
						check_variable = { var = COLDWAR_UAE_offer_round_bahrain value = 0 compare = greater_than }
						has_country_flag = COLDWAR_UAE_bahrain_charter_accepted
					}
				}
			}
			custom_effect_tooltip = TT_IF_THEY_ACCEPT
			set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_UAE_focus_preview_price_bahrain = gdp_total }
			multiply_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_UAE_focus_preview_price_bahrain = 0.02 }
			set_temp_variable = { treasury_change = COLDWAR_UAE_focus_preview_price_bahrain }
			multiply_temp_variable = { treasury_change = -1 }
			modify_treasury_effect = yes
			BHR = { add_ideas = COLDWAR_UAE_status_federal_charter_joined }
		}
	}
}

COLDWAR_UAE_close_bahrain_offer = {
	clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_UAE_offer_pending_bahrain
	clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_UAE_offer_awaiting_bahrain
	set_country_flag = { flag = COLDWAR_UAE_offer_cooldown_bahrain days = 180 }
}

COLDWAR_UAE_focus_qatar = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			tag = UAE
			IMP_is_1970_scenario = yes
			has_country_flag = COLDWAR_UAE_done_nine_states
			NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_UAE_focus_offer_delivered_qatar }
		}
		set_country_flag = COLDWAR_UAE_focus_offer_requested_qatar
		if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					has_country_flag = COLDWAR_UAE_focus_offer_delivered_qatar
					check_variable = { var = COLDWAR_UAE_offer_round_qatar value = 0 compare = greater_than }
					has_country_flag = COLDWAR_UAE_qatar_charter_accepted
				}
			}
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_UAE_focus_offer_delivered_qatar
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_UAE_focus_offer_requested_qatar
		}
		else = {
			if = {
				limit = {
					country_exists = QAT
					NOT = { has_war_with = QAT }
				}
				QAT = { save_event_target_as = COLDWAR_UAE_contract_recipient }
				COLDWAR_UAE_send_qatar_offer = yes
				if = {
					limit = {
						check_variable = { var = COLDWAR_UAE_offer_round_qatar value = 0 compare = greater_than }
					}
					set_country_flag = COLDWAR_UAE_focus_offer_delivered_qatar
					clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_UAE_focus_offer_requested_qatar
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

COLDWAR_UAE_focus_preview_qatar = {
	effect_tooltip = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = {
					OR = {
						has_country_flag = COLDWAR_UAE_focus_offer_delivered_qatar
						check_variable = { var = COLDWAR_UAE_offer_round_qatar value = 0 compare = greater_than }
						has_country_flag = COLDWAR_UAE_qatar_charter_accepted
					}
				}
			}
			custom_effect_tooltip = TT_IF_THEY_ACCEPT
			set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_UAE_focus_preview_price_qatar = gdp_total }
			multiply_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_UAE_focus_preview_price_qatar = 0.02 }
			set_temp_variable = { treasury_change = COLDWAR_UAE_focus_preview_price_qatar }
			multiply_temp_variable = { treasury_change = -1 }
			modify_treasury_effect = yes
			QAT = { add_ideas = COLDWAR_UAE_status_federal_charter_joined }
		}
	}
}

COLDWAR_UAE_close_qatar_offer = {
	clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_UAE_offer_pending_qatar
	clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_UAE_offer_awaiting_qatar
	set_country_flag = { flag = COLDWAR_UAE_offer_cooldown_qatar days = 180 }
}

COLDWAR_UAE_send_arab_exchange_offer = {
	if = {
	 limit = { COLDWAR_UAE_can_offer_arab_exchange = yes event_target:COLDWAR_UAE_contract_recipient = { exists = yes NOT = { tag = UAE } NOT = { has_war_with = UAE } NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_UAE_offer_cooldown_arab_exchange } } }
	 add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_UAE_offer_round_arab_exchange = 1 }
	 set_country_flag = { flag = COLDWAR_UAE_offer_pending_arab_exchange days = 60 }

COLDWAR_UAE_focus_arab_exchange = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			tag = UAE
			IMP_is_1970_scenario = yes
			has_country_flag = COLDWAR_UAE_done_arab_solidarity
			NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_UAE_focus_offer_delivered_arab_exchange }
		}
		set_country_flag = COLDWAR_UAE_focus_offer_requested_arab_exchange
		if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					has_country_flag = COLDWAR_UAE_focus_offer_delivered_arab_exchange
					check_variable = { var = COLDWAR_UAE_offer_round_arab_exchange value = 0 compare = greater_than }
				}
			}
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_UAE_focus_offer_delivered_arab_exchange
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_UAE_focus_offer_requested_arab_exchange
		}
		else = {
			if = {
				limit = {
					country_exists = EGY
					NOT = { has_war_with = EGY }
				}
				EGY = { save_event_target_as = COLDWAR_UAE_contract_recipient }
				COLDWAR_UAE_send_arab_exchange_offer = yes
				if = {
					limit = {
						check_variable = { var = COLDWAR_UAE_offer_round_arab_exchange value = 0 compare = greater_than }
					}
					set_country_flag = COLDWAR_UAE_focus_offer_delivered_arab_exchange
					clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_UAE_focus_offer_requested_arab_exchange
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

COLDWAR_UAE_focus_preview_arab_exchange = {
	effect_tooltip = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = {
					OR = {
						has_country_flag = COLDWAR_UAE_focus_offer_delivered_arab_exchange
						check_variable = { var = COLDWAR_UAE_offer_round_arab_exchange value = 0 compare = greater_than }
					}
				}
			}
			custom_effect_tooltip = TT_IF_THEY_ACCEPT
			set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_UAE_focus_preview_price_arab_exchange = gdp_total }
			multiply_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_UAE_focus_preview_price_arab_exchange = 0.02 }
			set_temp_variable = { treasury_change = COLDWAR_UAE_focus_preview_price_arab_exchange }
			multiply_temp_variable = { treasury_change = -1 }
			modify_treasury_effect = yes
			set_temp_variable = { temp_productivity_change = 10 }
			flat_productivity_change_effect = yes
			EGY = {
				set_temp_variable = { temp_productivity_change = 10 }
				flat_productivity_change_effect = yes
			}
		}
	}
}

COLDWAR_UAE_close_arab_exchange_offer = {
	clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_UAE_offer_pending_arab_exchange
	clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_UAE_offer_awaiting_arab_exchange
	set_country_flag = { flag = COLDWAR_UAE_offer_cooldown_arab_exchange days = 180 }
}

	 set_country_flag = COLDWAR_UAE_offer_awaiting_participation

COLDWAR_UAE_focus_participation = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			tag = UAE
			IMP_is_1970_scenario = yes
			has_country_flag = COLDWAR_UAE_done_state_participation
			NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_UAE_focus_offer_delivered_participation }
		}
		set_country_flag = COLDWAR_UAE_focus_offer_requested_participation
		if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					has_country_flag = COLDWAR_UAE_focus_offer_delivered_participation
					check_variable = { var = COLDWAR_UAE_offer_round_participation value = 0 compare = greater_than }
					has_country_flag = COLDWAR_UAE_oil_participation_accepted
				}
			}
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_UAE_focus_offer_delivered_participation
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_UAE_focus_offer_requested_participation
		}
		else = {
			if = {
				limit = {
					country_exists = ENG
					NOT = { has_war_with = ENG }
				}
				ENG = { save_event_target_as = COLDWAR_UAE_contract_recipient }
				COLDWAR_UAE_send_participation_offer = yes
				if = {
					limit = {
						check_variable = { var = COLDWAR_UAE_offer_round_participation value = 0 compare = greater_than }
					}
					set_country_flag = COLDWAR_UAE_focus_offer_delivered_participation
					clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_UAE_focus_offer_requested_participation
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

COLDWAR_UAE_focus_preview_participation = {
	effect_tooltip = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = {
					OR = {
						has_country_flag = COLDWAR_UAE_focus_offer_delivered_participation
						check_variable = { var = COLDWAR_UAE_offer_round_participation value = 0 compare = greater_than }
						has_country_flag = COLDWAR_UAE_oil_participation_accepted
					}
				}
			}
			custom_effect_tooltip = TT_IF_THEY_ACCEPT
			set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_UAE_focus_preview_price_participation = gdp_total }
			multiply_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_UAE_focus_preview_price_participation = 0.1 }
			set_temp_variable = { treasury_change = COLDWAR_UAE_focus_preview_price_participation }
			multiply_temp_variable = { treasury_change = -1 }
			modify_treasury_effect = yes
			ENG = {
				set_temp_variable = { treasury_change = UAE.COLDWAR_UAE_focus_preview_price_participation }
				modify_treasury_effect = yes
			}
		}
	}
}

COLDWAR_UAE_close_participation_offer = {
	clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_UAE_offer_pending_participation
	clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_UAE_offer_awaiting_participation
	set_country_flag = { flag = COLDWAR_UAE_offer_cooldown_participation days = 180 }
}

COLDWAR_UAE_send_training_offer_offer = {
	if = {
	 limit = { COLDWAR_UAE_can_offer_training_offer = yes event_target:COLDWAR_UAE_contract_recipient = { exists = yes NOT = { tag = UAE } NOT = { has_war_with = UAE } NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_UAE_offer_cooldown_training_offer } } }
	 add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_UAE_offer_round_training_offer = 1 }
	 set_country_flag = { flag = COLDWAR_UAE_offer_pending_training_offer days = 60 }
	 set_country_flag = COLDWAR_UAE_offer_awaiting_training_offer

	 set_country_flag = { flag = COLDWAR_UAE_offer_received_training_offer days = 60 }

COLDWAR_UAE_focus_training_offer = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			tag = UAE
			IMP_is_1970_scenario = yes
			has_country_flag = COLDWAR_UAE_done_security_contracts
			NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_UAE_focus_offer_delivered_training_offer }
		}
		set_country_flag = COLDWAR_UAE_focus_offer_requested_training_offer
		if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					has_country_flag = COLDWAR_UAE_focus_offer_delivered_training_offer
					check_variable = { var = COLDWAR_UAE_offer_round_training_offer value = 0 compare = greater_than }
				}
			}
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_UAE_focus_offer_delivered_training_offer
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_UAE_focus_offer_requested_training_offer
		}
		else = {
			if = {
				limit = {
					country_exists = ENG
					NOT = { has_war_with = ENG }
				}
				ENG = { save_event_target_as = COLDWAR_UAE_contract_recipient }
				COLDWAR_UAE_send_training_offer_offer = yes
				if = {
					limit = {
						check_variable = { var = COLDWAR_UAE_offer_round_training_offer value = 0 compare = greater_than }
					}
					set_country_flag = COLDWAR_UAE_focus_offer_delivered_training_offer
					clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_UAE_focus_offer_requested_training_offer
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

COLDWAR_UAE_focus_preview_training_offer = {
	effect_tooltip = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = {
					OR = {
						has_country_flag = COLDWAR_UAE_focus_offer_delivered_training_offer
						check_variable = { var = COLDWAR_UAE_offer_round_training_offer value = 0 compare = greater_than }
					}
				}
			}
			custom_effect_tooltip = TT_IF_THEY_ACCEPT
			set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_UAE_focus_preview_price_training_offer = gdp_total }
			multiply_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_UAE_focus_preview_price_training_offer = 0.02 }
			set_temp_variable = { treasury_change = COLDWAR_UAE_focus_preview_price_training_offer }
			multiply_temp_variable = { treasury_change = -1 }
			modify_treasury_effect = yes
			army_experience = 15
			add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_UAE_contract_foreign_training days = 730 }
		}
	}
}

COLDWAR_UAE_close_training_offer_offer = {
	clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_UAE_offer_pending_training_offer
	clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_UAE_offer_awaiting_training_offer
	set_country_flag = { flag = COLDWAR_UAE_offer_cooldown_training_offer days = 180 }
}

COLDWAR_UAE_send_exchange_offer_offer = {
	if = {
	 limit = { COLDWAR_UAE_can_offer_exchange_offer = yes event_target:COLDWAR_UAE_contract_recipient = { exists = yes NOT = { tag = UAE } NOT = { has_war_with = UAE } NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_UAE_offer_cooldown_exchange_offer } } }
	 add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_UAE_offer_round_exchange_offer = 1 }
	 set_country_flag = { flag = COLDWAR_UAE_offer_pending_exchange_offer days = 60 }
	 set_country_flag = COLDWAR_UAE_offer_awaiting_exchange_offer

COLDWAR_UAE_focus_exchange_offer = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			tag = UAE
			IMP_is_1970_scenario = yes
			has_country_flag = COLDWAR_UAE_done_technical_exchange
			NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_UAE_focus_offer_delivered_exchange_offer }
		}
		set_country_flag = COLDWAR_UAE_focus_offer_requested_exchange_offer
		if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					has_country_flag = COLDWAR_UAE_focus_offer_delivered_exchange_offer
					check_variable = { var = COLDWAR_UAE_offer_round_exchange_offer value = 0 compare = greater_than }
				}
			}
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_UAE_focus_offer_delivered_exchange_offer
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_UAE_focus_offer_requested_exchange_offer
		}
		else = {
			if = {
				limit = {
					country_exists = SOV
					NOT = { has_war_with = SOV }
				}
				SOV = { save_event_target_as = COLDWAR_UAE_contract_recipient }
				COLDWAR_UAE_send_exchange_offer_offer = yes
				if = {
					limit = {
						check_variable = { var = COLDWAR_UAE_offer_round_exchange_offer value = 0 compare = greater_than }
					}
					set_country_flag = COLDWAR_UAE_focus_offer_delivered_exchange_offer
					clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_UAE_focus_offer_requested_exchange_offer
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

COLDWAR_UAE_focus_preview_exchange_offer = {
	effect_tooltip = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = {
					OR = {
						has_country_flag = COLDWAR_UAE_focus_offer_delivered_exchange_offer
						check_variable = { var = COLDWAR_UAE_offer_round_exchange_offer value = 0 compare = greater_than }
					}
				}
			}
			custom_effect_tooltip = TT_IF_THEY_ACCEPT
			set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_UAE_focus_preview_price_exchange_offer = gdp_total }
			multiply_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_UAE_focus_preview_price_exchange_offer = 0.02 }
			set_temp_variable = { treasury_change = COLDWAR_UAE_focus_preview_price_exchange_offer }
			multiply_temp_variable = { treasury_change = -1 }
			modify_treasury_effect = yes
			set_temp_variable = { temp_productivity_change = 10 }
			flat_productivity_change_effect = yes
		}
	}
}

COLDWAR_UAE_close_exchange_offer_offer = {
	clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_UAE_offer_pending_exchange_offer
	clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_UAE_offer_awaiting_exchange_offer
	set_country_flag = { flag = COLDWAR_UAE_offer_cooldown_exchange_offer days = 180 }
}

	if = {
	 limit = { COLDWAR_UAE_can_offer_procurement = yes event_target:COLDWAR_UAE_contract_recipient = { exists = yes NOT = { tag = UAE } NOT = { has_war_with = UAE } NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_UAE_offer_cooldown_procurement } } }
	 add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_UAE_offer_round_procurement = 1 }
	 set_country_flag = { flag = COLDWAR_UAE_offer_pending_procurement days = 60 }

COLDWAR_UAE_focus_procurement = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			tag = UAE
			IMP_is_1970_scenario = yes
			has_country_flag = COLDWAR_UAE_done_air_coastal_shield
			NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_UAE_focus_offer_delivered_procurement }
		}
		set_country_flag = COLDWAR_UAE_focus_offer_requested_procurement
		if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					has_country_flag = COLDWAR_UAE_focus_offer_delivered_procurement
					check_variable = { var = COLDWAR_UAE_offer_round_procurement value = 0 compare = greater_than }
				}
			}
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_UAE_focus_offer_delivered_procurement
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_UAE_focus_offer_requested_procurement
		}
		else = {
			if = {
				limit = {
					country_exists = ENG
					NOT = { has_war_with = ENG }
				}
				ENG = { save_event_target_as = COLDWAR_UAE_contract_recipient }
				COLDWAR_UAE_send_procurement_offer = yes
				if = {
					limit = {
						check_variable = { var = COLDWAR_UAE_offer_round_procurement value = 0 compare = greater_than }
					}
					set_country_flag = COLDWAR_UAE_focus_offer_delivered_procurement
					clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_UAE_focus_offer_requested_procurement
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

COLDWAR_UAE_focus_preview_procurement = {
	effect_tooltip = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = {
					OR = {
						has_country_flag = COLDWAR_UAE_focus_offer_delivered_procurement
						check_variable = { var = COLDWAR_UAE_offer_round_procurement value = 0 compare = greater_than }
					}
				}
			}
			custom_effect_tooltip = TT_IF_THEY_ACCEPT
			set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_UAE_focus_preview_price_procurement = 0.25 }
			set_temp_variable = { treasury_change = COLDWAR_UAE_focus_preview_price_procurement }
			multiply_temp_variable = { treasury_change = -1 }
			modify_treasury_effect = yes
			ENG = {
				set_temp_variable = { treasury_change = UAE.COLDWAR_UAE_focus_preview_price_procurement }
				modify_treasury_effect = yes
				send_equipment = { type = infantry_weapons_1 amount = 1000 target = UAE }
			}
			custom_effect_tooltip = COLDWAR_UAE_procurement_confirmation_tt
		}
	}
}

COLDWAR_UAE_close_procurement_offer = {
	clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_UAE_offer_pending_procurement
	clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_UAE_offer_awaiting_procurement
	set_country_flag = { flag = COLDWAR_UAE_offer_cooldown_procurement days = 180 }
}

COLDWAR_UAE_focus_kuwait_support = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			tag = UAE
			IMP_is_1970_scenario = yes
			has_country_flag = COLDWAR_UAE_done_kuwait_support
			NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_UAE_focus_offer_delivered_kuwait_support }
		}
		set_country_flag = COLDWAR_UAE_focus_offer_requested_kuwait_support
		if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					has_country_flag = COLDWAR_UAE_focus_offer_delivered_kuwait_support
					check_variable = { var = COLDWAR_UAE_offer_round_kuwait_support value = 0 compare = greater_than }
				}
			}
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_UAE_focus_offer_delivered_kuwait_support
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_UAE_focus_offer_requested_kuwait_support
		}
		else = {
			if = {
				limit = {
					country_exists = KUW
					NOT = { has_war_with = KUW }
				}
				KUW = { save_event_target_as = COLDWAR_UAE_contract_recipient }
				COLDWAR_UAE_send_kuwait_support_offer = yes
				if = {
					limit = {
						check_variable = { var = COLDWAR_UAE_offer_round_kuwait_support value = 0 compare = greater_than }
					}
					set_country_flag = COLDWAR_UAE_focus_offer_delivered_kuwait_support
					clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_UAE_focus_offer_requested_kuwait_support
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

COLDWAR_UAE_focus_preview_kuwait_support = {
	effect_tooltip = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = {
					OR = {
						has_country_flag = COLDWAR_UAE_focus_offer_delivered_kuwait_support
						check_variable = { var = COLDWAR_UAE_offer_round_kuwait_support value = 0 compare = greater_than }
					}
				}
			}
			custom_effect_tooltip = TT_IF_THEY_ACCEPT
			set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_UAE_focus_preview_price_kuwait_support = gdp_total }
			multiply_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_UAE_focus_preview_price_kuwait_support = 0.03 }
			set_temp_variable = { treasury_change = COLDWAR_UAE_focus_preview_price_kuwait_support }
			multiply_temp_variable = { treasury_change = -1 }
			modify_treasury_effect = yes
			KUW = {
				set_temp_variable = { treasury_change = UAE.COLDWAR_UAE_focus_preview_price_kuwait_support }
				modify_treasury_effect = yes
			}
		}
	}
}

COLDWAR_UAE_close_kuwait_support_offer = {
	clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_UAE_offer_pending_kuwait_support
	clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_UAE_offer_awaiting_kuwait_support
	set_country_flag = { flag = COLDWAR_UAE_offer_cooldown_kuwait_support days = 180 }
}

COLDWAR_UAE_focus_kuwait_transit = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			tag = UAE
			IMP_is_1970_scenario = yes
			has_country_flag = COLDWAR_UAE_done_kuwait_transit
			NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_UAE_focus_offer_delivered_kuwait_transit }
		}
		set_country_flag = COLDWAR_UAE_focus_offer_requested_kuwait_transit
		if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					has_country_flag = COLDWAR_UAE_focus_offer_delivered_kuwait_transit
					check_variable = { var = COLDWAR_UAE_offer_round_kuwait_transit value = 0 compare = greater_than }
				}
			}
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_UAE_focus_offer_delivered_kuwait_transit
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_UAE_focus_offer_requested_kuwait_transit
		}
		else = {
			if = {
				limit = {
					country_exists = KUW
					NOT = { has_war_with = KUW }
				}
				KUW = { save_event_target_as = COLDWAR_UAE_contract_recipient }
				COLDWAR_UAE_send_kuwait_transit_offer = yes
				if = {
					limit = {
						check_variable = { var = COLDWAR_UAE_offer_round_kuwait_transit value = 0 compare = greater_than }
					}
					set_country_flag = COLDWAR_UAE_focus_offer_delivered_kuwait_transit
					clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_UAE_focus_offer_requested_kuwait_transit
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

COLDWAR_UAE_focus_preview_kuwait_transit = {
	effect_tooltip = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = {
					OR = {
						has_country_flag = COLDWAR_UAE_focus_offer_delivered_kuwait_transit
						check_variable = { var = COLDWAR_UAE_offer_round_kuwait_transit value = 0 compare = greater_than }
					}
				}
			}
			custom_effect_tooltip = TT_IF_THEY_ACCEPT
			set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_UAE_focus_preview_price_kuwait_transit = gdp_total }
			multiply_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_UAE_focus_preview_price_kuwait_transit = 0 }
			give_military_access = KUW
		}
	}
}

COLDWAR_UAE_close_kuwait_transit_offer = {
	clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_UAE_offer_pending_kuwait_transit
	clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_UAE_offer_awaiting_kuwait_transit
	set_country_flag = { flag = COLDWAR_UAE_offer_cooldown_kuwait_transit days = 180 }
}

COLDWAR_UAE_focus_kuwait_deployment = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			tag = UAE
			IMP_is_1970_scenario = yes
			has_country_flag = COLDWAR_UAE_done_kuwait_deployment
			NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_UAE_focus_offer_delivered_kuwait_deployment }
		}
		set_country_flag = COLDWAR_UAE_focus_offer_requested_kuwait_deployment
		if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					has_country_flag = COLDWAR_UAE_focus_offer_delivered_kuwait_deployment
					check_variable = { var = COLDWAR_UAE_offer_round_kuwait_deployment value = 0 compare = greater_than }
				}
			}
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_UAE_focus_offer_delivered_kuwait_deployment
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_UAE_focus_offer_requested_kuwait_deployment
		}
		else = {
			if = {
				limit = {
					country_exists = KUW
					NOT = { has_war_with = KUW }
				}
				KUW = { save_event_target_as = COLDWAR_UAE_contract_recipient }
				COLDWAR_UAE_send_kuwait_deployment_offer = yes
				if = {
					limit = {
						check_variable = { var = COLDWAR_UAE_offer_round_kuwait_deployment value = 0 compare = greater_than }
					}
					set_country_flag = COLDWAR_UAE_focus_offer_delivered_kuwait_deployment
					clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_UAE_focus_offer_requested_kuwait_deployment
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

COLDWAR_UAE_focus_preview_kuwait_deployment = {
	effect_tooltip = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = {
					OR = {
						has_country_flag = COLDWAR_UAE_focus_offer_delivered_kuwait_deployment
						check_variable = { var = COLDWAR_UAE_offer_round_kuwait_deployment value = 0 compare = greater_than }
					}
				}
			}
			custom_effect_tooltip = TT_IF_THEY_ACCEPT
			set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_UAE_focus_preview_price_kuwait_deployment = gdp_total }
			multiply_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_UAE_focus_preview_price_kuwait_deployment = 0 }
			KUW = { give_military_access = UAE }
		}
	}
}

COLDWAR_UAE_close_kuwait_deployment_offer = {
	clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_UAE_offer_pending_kuwait_deployment
	clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_UAE_offer_awaiting_kuwait_deployment
	set_country_flag = { flag = COLDWAR_UAE_offer_cooldown_kuwait_deployment days = 180 }
}

COLDWAR_UAE_check_broad_charter = {
	if = { limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_UAE_bahrain_charter_accepted has_country_flag = COLDWAR_UAE_qatar_charter_accepted } set_country_flag = COLDWAR_UAE_broad_charter_accepted COLDWAR_UAE_refresh_programmes = yes }
}

COLDWAR_UAE_retry_focus_offers = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			tag = UAE
			IMP_is_1970_scenario = yes
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_country_flag = COLDWAR_UAE_focus_offer_requested_bahrain
			}
			COLDWAR_UAE_focus_bahrain = yes
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_country_flag = COLDWAR_UAE_focus_offer_requested_qatar
			}
			COLDWAR_UAE_focus_qatar = yes
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_country_flag = COLDWAR_UAE_focus_offer_requested_arab_exchange
			}
			COLDWAR_UAE_focus_arab_exchange = yes
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_country_flag = COLDWAR_UAE_focus_offer_requested_participation
			}
			COLDWAR_UAE_focus_participation = yes
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_country_flag = COLDWAR_UAE_focus_offer_requested_procurement
			}
			COLDWAR_UAE_focus_procurement = yes
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_country_flag = COLDWAR_UAE_focus_offer_requested_training_offer
			}
			COLDWAR_UAE_focus_training_offer = yes
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_country_flag = COLDWAR_UAE_focus_offer_requested_exchange_offer
			}
			COLDWAR_UAE_focus_exchange_offer = yes
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_country_flag = COLDWAR_UAE_focus_offer_requested_british_cofinance
			}
			COLDWAR_UAE_focus_british_cofinance = yes
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_country_flag = COLDWAR_UAE_focus_offer_requested_kuwait_support
			}
			COLDWAR_UAE_focus_kuwait_support = yes
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_country_flag = COLDWAR_UAE_focus_offer_requested_kuwait_transit
			}
			COLDWAR_UAE_focus_kuwait_transit = yes
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_country_flag = COLDWAR_UAE_focus_offer_requested_kuwait_deployment
			}
			COLDWAR_UAE_focus_kuwait_deployment = yes
		}
	}
}

COLDWAR_UAE_update_decision_prices = {
	set_variable = { COLDWAR_UAE_estimate_reserve_deposit = COLDWAR_UAE_start_gdp }
	multiply_variable = { COLDWAR_UAE_estimate_reserve_deposit = 0.05 }
}

COLDWAR_UAE_british_tick = {
	if = { limit = { tag = UAE IMP_is_1970_scenario = yes }
		COLDWAR_UAE_execute_release = yes
		COLDWAR_UAE_update_decision_prices = yes
		COLDWAR_UAE_retry_focus_offers = yes
		clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_UAE_course_running_residency
		clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_UAE_course_running_industry_project
		clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_UAE_course_running_labour_inspection
		clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_UAE_course_running_association_law
		clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_UAE_course_running_port_project
		clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_UAE_course_running_airline
		clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_UAE_course_running_industrial_power
		clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_UAE_course_running_housing
		clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_UAE_course_running_housing_workers
		clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_UAE_course_running_training
		clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_UAE_course_running_maintenance
		clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_UAE_course_running_scholarships
		clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_UAE_course_running_vocational
		clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_UAE_course_running_charity_oversight
		if = { limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_UAE_offer_awaiting_protection OR = {
			NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_UAE_offer_pending_protection }
			NOT = { check_variable = { var = COLDWAR_UAE_offer_treaty_context_protection value = COLDWAR_UAE_treaty_nonce compare = equals } }
		} } COLDWAR_UAE_close_protection_offer = yes }
		if = { limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_UAE_offer_awaiting_friendship OR = {
			NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_UAE_offer_pending_friendship }
			NOT = { check_variable = { var = COLDWAR_UAE_offer_treaty_context_friendship value = COLDWAR_UAE_treaty_nonce compare = equals } }
		} } COLDWAR_UAE_close_friendship_offer = yes }
		if = { limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_UAE_offer_awaiting_british_cofinance OR = {
			NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_UAE_offer_pending_british_cofinance }
			NOT = { check_variable = { var = COLDWAR_UAE_offer_treaty_context_british_cofinance value = COLDWAR_UAE_treaty_nonce compare = equals } }
		} } COLDWAR_UAE_close_british_cofinance_offer = yes }
		if = { limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_UAE_offer_awaiting_bahrain NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_UAE_offer_pending_bahrain } } COLDWAR_UAE_close_bahrain_offer = yes }
